_doc: Index of atlas folders. Written by the assembly script (see README_PAIRING.md §10). The browser cannot list directories, so this file is the authoritative answer to 'what atlases are installed?'. atlas_discovery.js reads this at startup.
_notes_2026_05_23: Phase 1a complete. cross-species / evolution / popstats migrated OUT to their own standalone Desktop repos (cross-species-atlas, evolution-atlas, popstats-atlas) and registered in atlas-core/build/atlas.config. inversion-atlas now ships only the 'inversion' atlas package. NB: this _index.json is not consumed at assemble time (assemble.sh writes the workspace-level atlases/_index.json from the directory scan); kept here as documentation for what THIS repo provides.
